title: 第802章 哼！
slug: 宗门收徒我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

钱清闻言没有迟疑，果断点头同意。

陈白青目光转而望向一旁的一老一小两个沙弥，也没兴趣追问两人前因后果，只是语气温和道：

“多谢两位道友帮的忙，这位钱清的确认识我师父，有劳两位奔波一番，不如先去会客厅歇息一番，到时候有厚礼赠送。”

倒悬寺的小和尚在一旁听的顿觉天地倒转，恍若如梦。

他千想万想都没敢想面前的纯粹武夫竟然真的认识楚星尘。

果然是世事难预料。

方丈看了眼钱清，神色微微迟疑之后，还是行礼柔声询问道：

“道友确定钱清认识尊师吗？”

陈白青自然明白方丈担忧，直接了当道：

“这里是天衍宗，没人也没空逗一个武夫玩。”

陈白青虽然未真见过钱清，但是收拢整理情报的时候，陈白青还是有额外留意师父都在做些什么，如果万一师父准备做些蠢事，身为弟子自然要试着阻拦。

刚刚回忆了片刻，倒也记得是有钱清这个纯粹武夫的记载，也和缘空有所关联。

方丈了然的点了点头，接着松了口气道：

“那便多谢道友了，厚礼便罢了，是我们自己应的钱施主，要不得酬劳，歇也不用了，老衲还有些琐碎事要办，就不再叨扰贵宗了。”

陈白青没有强留，微微行礼：“多谢道友。”

方丈轻笑点了点头，随后伸手摸了摸一旁还在愣神的小沙弥，拉着它的衣领子便离开了。

陈白青目光看向一旁的天衍宗弟子询问道：

“他们是哪里的？”

“自称是倒悬寺的。”

“以我师父的名义，送一份礼到倒悬寺去。”

“明白了，这就去办。”

“有劳了。”陈白青点头应过，接着望向了一旁的钱清，微微抬手用灵力托起钱清便往天衍宗里而去。

只是片刻，三道身影便落在了相亲相爱一家的半山腰。

陈白青望了眼山顶，轻声道：

“我不算懂武夫境界，不过半山腰想来你是能走的，边走边聊会可好？”

钱清回过神来：“劳烦仙家，自是可以。”

林洛雨站在一旁，目光打量了一番钱清，神色虽然有些明显的慌张，但语气仍然不卑不亢，倒也有些意思。

钱清整理思绪，准备好回答陈白青追问前因后果的询问。

只是，陈白青要问的很明显并非是这些。

Page (1/3)

Qian Qing did not hesitate when he heard the words and nodded decisively in agreement.

Chen Baiqing turned to look at the two novices, an old man and a young man, on the side. He was not interested in questioning the cause and effect of the two people, and just said in a gentle tone:

"Thank you two Taoist friends for your help. This Qian Qing does know my master. Since you two have a lot of work to do, why not go to the living room to rest first. I will give you a generous gift when the time comes."

The young monk in the Xuanxuan Temple suddenly felt that the world was turning upside down, as if in a dream.

He never dared to imagine that the pure martial artist in front of him actually knew Chu Xingchen.

As expected, things are unpredictable.

The abbot glanced at Qian Qing, and after a slight hesitation, he saluted and asked softly:

"Fellow Taoist, are you sure Qian Qing knows your revered master?"

Chen Baiqing naturally understood the abbot's concerns and said directly:

"This is Tianyan Sect, no one has time to tease a martial artist."

Although Chen Baiqing has never actually met Qian Qing, when gathering and sorting out information, Chen Baiqing still pays extra attention to what his master is doing. If the master is going to do something stupid, as a disciple, he will naturally try to stop him.

I just recalled it for a moment, but I also remembered that the record of Qian Qing, a pure martial artist, was also related to Yuan Kong.

The abbot nodded clearly, then breathed a sigh of relief and said:

"Then thank you fellow Taoist, it's just a generous gift. We are the donors of the money we owe. If we don't get any reward, we don't need to rest. I still have some trivial things to do, so I won't bother your sect anymore."

Chen Baiqing did not force him to stay, and bowed slightly: "Thank you, fellow Taoist."

The abbot chuckled and nodded, then reached out to touch the little novice monk who was still dazed beside him, pulled its collar and left.

Chen Baiqing looked at the Tianyan Sect disciples aside and asked:

"Where are they from?"

"He claims to be from the Daoxuan Temple."

"In the name of my master, I would like to send a gift to Daixuan Temple."

"I understand, let's do it now."

"Thank you." Chen Baiqing nodded in response, then looked at Qian Qing aside, raised his hand slightly, used his spiritual power to lift Qian Qing, and headed towards Tianyan Sect.

In just a moment, three figures landed on the mountainside where a loving family lived.

Chen Baiqing looked at the top of the mountain and said softly:

"I don't know the realm of martial arts, but I think you can walk halfway up the mountain. How about we chat while we walk?"

Qian Qing came to his senses and said, "It's okay to bother the Immortal family."

Lin Luoyu stood aside and looked at Qian Qing. Although his expression was obviously panicked, his tone was still neither humble nor arrogant, but it was also somewhat interesting.

Qian Qing organized his thoughts and prepared to answer Chen Baiqing's inquiry about the causes and consequences.

However, it was obvious that what Chen Baiqing wanted to ask was not these.
